Test case Name: Verify forms appear after the effective date
Description: Verify that the Marsh Private Panel endorsement forms are available when the submission effective date is after 10/09/2026
Actions: 1. Log in to EZ Docs|2. Select Financial Lines LOB|3. Open a D&O submission with effective date after 10/09/2026|4. Select Marsh Private Panel from the product dropdown|5. Enter all mandatory fields|6. Open the endorsement section and click Add Endorsement

Test case Name: Block submission when mandatory fields are left blank
Description: Verify that missing mandatory values prevent the form from being saved or submitted
Actions: 1. Open the endorsement section|2. Select a form such as ZC-Marsh PP-14102 U|3. Leave required fields blank|4. Click Save or Continue|5. Review the validation response
Expected Results: 1. The form is not saved|2. A validation message is shown for the missing mandatory field|3. The user remains on the same form screen

Test case Name: Reject invalid dates in the litigation and run-off fields
Description: Verify that invalid date formats or impossible dates are rejected before the form can be saved
Actions: 1. Open a form with date fields|2. Enter an invalid date format or a date outside the expected range|3. Click Save or Continue|4. Observe the validation behavior
Expected Results: 1. The invalid date is rejected|2. A clear validation message is displayed|3. The form remains unsaved until the date is corrected

Test case Name: Reject invalid amounts in retention and limit fields
Description: Verify that non numeric or malformed amount values are blocked for the monetary fields
Actions: 1. Open a form containing amount fields such as ZC-Marsh PP-14105 or ZC-Marsh PP-14106|2. Enter a text value or malformed amount|3. Click Save or Continue|4. Review the result
Expected Results: 1. The invalid amount is rejected|2. A validation error is shown|3. The form does not proceed to the next step

Test case Name: Reject invalid date sequencing for policy period extension
Description: Verify that an expiry date earlier than the inception date is blocked
Actions: 1. Open form ZC-Marsh PP-14111|2. Enter an expiry date earlier than the from date|3. Click Save or Continue|4. Review the error state
Expected Results: 1. The invalid sequence is rejected|2. A validation message is displayed|3. The form stays in the editable state until corrected

Test case Name: Block forms when required free text is missing
Description: Verify that forms requiring entity or organization names cannot be saved without the required free text entry
Actions: 1. Open a form such as ZC-Marsh PP-14108 U or ZC-Marsh PP-14115 U|2. Leave the required free text field empty|3. Click Save or Continue|4. Review the validation outcome
